subject: Consolidate technical walkthrough + procurement/security touchpoint
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Park <oliver.park@skylineai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidate technical walkthrough + procurement/security touchpoint

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. To keep momentum I wanted to propose a single consolidated session that covers: (1) a technical walkthrough with our Solutions Engineering team, (2) a short live Q&A for your engineers, and (3) a procurement/security touchpoint at the end for next‑steps and contracting items.

Estimated length: 75–90 minutes (we can compress to 60 if you'd prefer two separate sessions). Could you confirm whether procurement and security would attend the same call, or if they need a separate follow-up? If they can join, here are a few proposed slots (all PT):
• Thu, Mar 25 — 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:30
• Fri, Mar 26 — 09:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30
• Mon, Mar 29 — 11:00–12:30

If none of those work, send a couple windows and we’ll adapt. Quick asks for the session so Marissa can prepare:
- list of attendee roles (engineer, security, procurement)
- any non‑public sample data or connection constraints
- target success criteria for the walkthrough

I’ll send a calendar invite once we land on a time.

Thanks —
Vivek
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Oliver Park <oliver.park@skylineai.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: alyssa.chen@skylineai.com, procurement@skylineai.com
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidate technical walkthrough + procurement/security touchpoint

Vivek —

Appreciate the proposal. Quick constraints from our side: procurement prefers afternoons PT and typically needs the legal/price topics separated into a short follow-up (30m). Security (Alyssa) is only available Mon/Wed mornings next week due to an offsite. Our eng team can do a longer session but would prefer something that starts after 10am PT.

Attendees I expect:
- Oliver Park (Engineering Lead)
- Carlos Rivera (Platform Eng) — will join the technical portion
- Alyssa Chen (Security) — limited availability Mon/Wed am
- procurement@skylineai.com — prefers to be looped for contract docs only

Given that, would you be open to either:
A) A single consolidated 90‑minute session on Mon, Mar 29 at 11:00 PT (security makes an exception to join later in the call), or
B) Split: technical deep-dive Fri, Mar 26 13:00 PT (60–75m) + procurement/contract call the following week.

Also please share any SOC2 / attestation docs we can preview for procurement.

—Oliver
Oliver Park | SkylineAI

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Park <oliver.park@skylineai.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidate technical walkthrough + procurement/security touchpoint

Thanks, Oliver — helpful constraints.

We can do a consolidated 90‑minute session but I want to be explicit about agenda so it respects everyone’s time. Proposed agenda (90m):
1) 0–10m: Intros and success criteria (Vivek / Oliver)
2) 10–50m: Architecture walkthrough + demo (Marissa)
3) 50–70m: Deep technical Q&A and connection patterns (Carlos & Eng team)
4) 70–85m: Security notes, network/firewall checklist (Marissa + Alyssa if available)
5) 85–90m: Action items and procurement next steps (Vivek)

If procurement prefers a dedicated legal/price conversation we can still split that off into a 30m follow-up — but having procurement present at the end to confirm required docs is usually efficient.

Requests for prep (please send ahead if possible):
- sample request/response payloads or a short test dataset (sanitized)
- any IP/data isolation requirements
- a primary contact for your SSO/KMS questions

I’ll tentatively hold Mon, Mar 29 11:00–12:30 PT and Fri, Mar 26 13:00–14:15 PT on my calendar until we confirm. Also attaching a short pre-demo checklist so engineering can see the connection requirements.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[attachment: pre-demo-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: procurement@skylineai.com
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@skylineai.com
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 09:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidate technical walkthrough + procurement/security touchpoint

Hi Vivek / Marissa —

Thanks for looping procurement in. To move forward we need a SOC2 summary (or attestation) and a draft statement of work / order form that includes pricing bands and renewal terms. Please also confirm data retention and deletion policies.

Can you provide the following items before a procurement call is scheduled?
• SOC2 summary / evidence (PDF)
• Draft order form (Word/PDF)
• Standard SLA language and data handling policy

If you have a DocuSign or hosted link for the order form that speeds review — please include it. We typically route final contracts via contracts@skylineai.com.

Procurement Team | SkylineAI

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Park <oliver.park@skylineai.com>, procurement@skylineai.com, alyssa.chen@skylineai.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, contracts@skylineai.com
Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidate technical walkthrough + procurement/security touchpoint — reschedule to accommodate exec conflict

Quick update: an internal exec conflict popped up for Mar 29 and several folks on our side will be tied up that morning. To avoid last-minute churn I propose we move the consolidated session to Tue, Mar 30 at 10:00–11:30 PT. Marissa and Karthik confirmed availability for that slot and we can keep the agenda proposed below. If procurement still prefers a separate legal/price review, we can schedule a 30m slot Wed, Mar 31 — I’ll route a DocuSign/order-form link once I have procurement’s preferred contact.

Final agenda (confirmed):
- 0–10m: Intros & success criteria (Vivek / Oliver)
- 10–50m: Architecture walkthrough & demo (Marissa)
- 50–70m: Deep technical Q&A (Carlos & Eng)
- 70–85m: Security checklist & discussion (Alyssa)
- 85–90m: Next steps & procurement asks (Vivek)

Attachments I’m attaching to this thread: pre-demo-checklist.xlsx and a short SOC2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf). I’ll also add a tentative calendar invite for Tue, Mar 30 10:00–11:30 PT — please accept or propose an alternative window.

Next actions:
• Oliver — confirm that Mar 30 10:00 PT works for engineering + security (or propose an alternative)
• Procurement — confirm receiving redwood-soc2-summary.pdf and send preferred contract contact for DocuSign
• Marissa / SEs — prep connection demo and bring network checklist

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the session.

Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
